name: Creepish
look: a creepy fish-man on bent frog legs with raised clawed blue arms, a green fish face with ringed goggle eyes and a toothy mouth in a great black frill, a scaled blue belly and a dark green back
entry: It lurks in dark lagoons with only its frill above the water. When it spreads the frill and raises its arms, even large Pokémon back away.
how: Evolve Fishugly at level 36. It learns Throat Chop when it evolves.
